detail.heroDescription: Decorative or corrosion-resistant parts plated on ABS, ABS/PC or metal substrates. Sequence: surface pretreatment, plating by the process suited to the substrate (nickel-chrome on plastic; nickel, zinc, copper, tin and black manganese phosphating on metal), then thickness measurement and salt spray testing.

overviewParagraphs.p1: For ABS or ABS/PC plastic, parts are mounted on racks, then go through degreasing, etching, neutralization, HCl activation and palladium activation before nickel-chrome plating. Satin nickel, black chrome and hairline finish layers are built on this base.
overviewParagraphs.p2: For metals such as iron, steel, copper and aluminum, the process is degreasing, rust removal and activation, then nickel, zinc, copper, tin plating or black phosphating, depending on the part's requirement. Small parts can be barrel plated; larger parts are rack plated.
overviewParagraphs.p3: After plating, parts are dried, plating thickness is measured, salt spray testing is done as required, and the finished goods are inspected before packing.

step1.title: Receiving and Pretreatment
step1.description: Goods receipt, storage, ultrasonic degreasing, HCl tank, surface activation; water rinse between steps.

step2.title: Racking and Plating
step2.description: ABS plastic: nickel-chrome plating on the automatic rack plating line. Metal: nickel, zinc, copper, tin plating or black phosphating on the rack or barrel plating line.

step3.title: Surface finish
step3.description: Satin, black chrome or hairline finish is made as required, then dried. Painting or printing can be added.

step4.title: Inspection and packing
step4.description: Plating thickness measurement, salt spray testing, final inspection, packing.
